query:
WITH managed_sources AS (
                SELECT
                    id,
                    collection_id,
                    source_key::bigint AS tmdb_collection_id
                FROM collection_sources
                WHERE provider = 'tmdb'
                  AND source_kind = 'tmdb_collection'
                  AND source_scope_key = 'global'
                  AND collection_id IS NOT NULL
                  AND source_key ~ '^[0-9]+$'
            ), legacy_members AS (
                SELECT DISTINCT ON (mcm.collection_id, mr.tmdb_id)
                    ms.id AS source_id,
                    ms.collection_id,
                    mcm.collection_id AS tmdb_collection_id,
                    mcm.movie_id,
                    mr.tmdb_id,
                    mr.title,
                    NULLIF(btrim(mcm.poster_path), '') AS poster_path,
                    NULLIF(btrim(mcm.backdrop_path), '') AS backdrop_path,
                    mf.is_available
                FROM movie_collection_membership mcm
                JOIN movie_references mr ON mr.id = mcm.movie_id
                JOIN managed_sources ms
                  ON ms.tmdb_collection_id = mcm.collection_id
                LEFT JOIN media_files mf ON mf.id = mr.file_id
                ORDER BY
                    mcm.collection_id,
                    mr.tmdb_id,
                    mf.is_available DESC NULLS LAST,
                    mr.updated_at DESC,
                    mcm.movie_id
            ), upsert_members AS (
                INSERT INTO collection_source_memberships (
                    source_id,
                    collection_id,
                    item_key,
                    media_type,
                    media_id,
                    external_media_type,
                    external_id,
                    external_position,
                    source_order_key,
                    title,
                    poster_path,
                    backdrop_path,
                    match_status,
                    matched_at,
                    legacy_movie_collection_movie_id,
                    legacy_movie_collection_tmdb_id,
                    payload
                )
                SELECT
                    source_id,
                    collection_id,
                    'movie:' || movie_id::text,
                    'movie'::media_type,
                    movie_id,
                    'movie',
                    tmdb_id::text,
                    NULL::integer,
                    lpad(tmdb_id::text, 20, '0'),
                    title,
                    poster_path,
                    backdrop_path,
                    'matched',
                    NOW(),
                    movie_id,
                    tmdb_collection_id,
                    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
                        'tmdb_movie_id', tmdb_id::text,
                        'tmdb_collection_id', tmdb_collection_id::text,
                        'legacy_movie_collection_movie_id', movie_id::text
                    ))
                FROM legacy_members
                ON CONFLICT (source_id, external_media_type, external_id)
                    DO UPDATE SET
                        collection_id = EXCLUDED.collection_id,
                        item_key = EXCLUDED.item_key,
                        media_type = EXCLUDED.media_type,
                        media_id = EXCLUDED.media_id,
                        source_order_key = EXCLUDED.source_order_key,
                        title = EXCLUDED.title,
                        poster_path = EXCLUDED.poster_path,
                        backdrop_path = EXCLUDED.backdrop_path,
                        match_status = 'matched',
                        matched_at = NOW(),
                        legacy_movie_collection_movie_id =
                            EXCLUDED.legacy_movie_collection_movie_id,
                        legacy_movie_collection_tmdb_id =
                            EXCLUDED.legacy_movie_collection_tmdb_id,
                        payload = EXCLUDED.payload,
                        updated_at = NOW()
                RETURNING id
            ), delete_stale AS (
                DELETE FROM collection_source_memberships csm
                USING managed_sources ms
                WHERE csm.source_id = ms.id
                  AND csm.legacy_movie_collection_tmdb_id IS NOT NULL
                  AND csm.external_media_type = 'movie'
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM legacy_members lm
                        WHERE lm.source_id = csm.source_id
                          AND lm.tmdb_id::text = csm.external_id
                  )
                RETURNING csm.id
            )
            SELECT
                (SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint FROM upsert_members) AS "upserted!",
                (SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint FROM delete_stale) AS "removed!"
